cycle_1.hypothesis: raw lag similarity normalized by global trajectory span aliases smooth monotone trends into false PRODUCTIVE_LIMIT_CYCLE evidence
cycle_1.counterhypothesis: because the probe is advisory and also requires boundedness/utility/pressure, the raw lag heuristic is sufficiently discriminative

external_research.finding: linear/constant detrending is an explicit preprocessing operation for trend removal before residual signal analysis

external_research.source: Trends in recurrence analysis of dynamical systems (2024 review)
external_research.finding: recurrence analysis requires explicit treatment of nonstationarity, parameterization and failure modes rather than raw similarity alone

cycle_1.implementation: detrend state_delta by least-squares linear trend; compute lag similarity on residuals; require >=2 raw direction changes; keep boundedness/utility/pressure gates

cycle_2.hypothesis: replay and comparison are ambiguous if diagnostic policy/semantic version and state basis identity are not receipt-visible
cycle_2.counterhypothesis: input hashes and surrounding repository head are sufficient
cycle_2.fusion_with_concurrent_worker: Concurrent worker independently hardened the H1 quality gate and trajectory probe with residual estimator identity/version/freshness/uncertainty and policy-bound receipt identity. This supports the provenance direction and was preserved during rebase.

cycle_3.hypothesis: timestamp-only or loosely correlated logs are insufficient for deterministic asynchronous/multi-node FRANK reconstruction; causal envelope should bind trace/root span, parent span, cycle, state epoch/version, node/resource identity and policy/code identity
cycle_3.counterhypothesis: single-process H1 cycle_id plus state epoch already reconstructs enough causality; wider trace metadata may add cost without improving fault localization
